title: pam_rule v1
description: One rule of a PAM service stack, in evaluation order, with include, substack and @include already resolved: the engine sees the stack PAM runs. Emitted before the pam_snapshot of the same run_id.

service.description: PAM service: the file name under /etc/pam.d (sshd, login, su, common-password...).

position.description: 0-based order inside the resolved stack of the service.

control.description: required, requisite, sufficient, optional, or a [value=action ...] block as written.

args.description: The arguments the controls judge (deny, unlock_time, minlen, minclass, the credits, dictcheck, remember, obscure, trust); others never leave the machine.

file.description: File the rule is written in (an included one, possibly).

via.description: Include chain from the service file, outermost first.

module_missing.description: The module file is not installed: PAM skips a "-" rule and fails a plain one, so the rule enforces nothing.
